request.note: The speed limit in px per second. The server reads it as `parseInt(payload)`, so a numeric string works too (`"50px"` gives 50). `0`, a missing payload (it becomes `{}`) or any value that gives `NaN` removes the limit. There is no range check: a negative value gives the minimum speed, 5 (`round(max(5, speed))`, node/server.js:1761-1762).

responses.name: Update
responses.when: Always when you have a character, before the `game_response`.
responses.summary: Your character (`u+cid`). The server recalculates `speed` as `min(speed, cruise || 200000)`.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: Always when you have a character.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: The stored value, `parseInt(payload)`. `NaN` arrives as `null` in JSON.
